description: Get paginated timeseries data points for one UK health surveillance metric (cases, deaths, healthcare admissions, testing, vaccinations, etc.) at a specific geography, identified by the full theme/sub_theme/topic/geography_type/geography/metric path from ukhsa-dashboard.browse. Optional filters: year, epiweek, exact date, age band, sex, stratum, and reporting-delay-period flag. Data: api.ukhsa-dashboard.data.gov.uk, UK Open Government Licence v3.0, no auth required.

age.description: Filter by age band as published for this metric (e.g. "all", "15-44")

date.description: Filter to a single exact date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2023-06-15")

epiweek.description: Filter to a single epidemiological week number (1-53)

in_reporting_delay_period.description: Filter to rows still within the provisional reporting-delay window

metric.description: Metric name from ukhsa-dashboard.browse at the metrics level (e.g. "COVID-19_cases_casesByDay")

page_size.description: Number of data points per page (1-500, default 100)

sex.description: Filter by sex as published for this metric (e.g. "all", "f", "m")

stratum.description: Filter by stratum/breakdown as published for this metric (e.g. "default")

year.description: Filter to a single calendar year (e.g. 2023)

name: ukhsa-dashboard.metrics.data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UKHSA Dashboard Metric Data
